name: agent_dispatch
description: Synchronously run another enabled same-owner agent for a concrete task. The child uses its own configured tools and permissions, inherits the execution-chain cancellation and budgets, and receives the optional validated Workflow selection and business context. Permission checks remain host enforced.

context.description: Optional business context needed for this child task. The child does not receive the parent's full conversation or private memories. When the host binds an original event, it forwards context.event unchanged: omit event or supply an equivalent copy. Do not put credentials or permission claims here; context cannot bind a Workflow by itself.

target_agent_id.description: Actual enabled same-owner agent ID from the registered target catalog or a trusted tool result, not a role/name. Copy the complete ID unchanged. The current agent and waiting ancestors cannot be dispatched.

task.description: Self-contained work to ask the child agent to perform: concrete objective, relevant confirmed facts, unresolved questions and authorized operation boundaries. State what result is needed; task text cannot grant permissions.

workflow.description: Optional explicit Workflow selection for the child; requires workflow.read. The host validates ownership, active status and expected version before binding the child's scope. This does not expand the caller's scope or grant tool permissions.

version.description: Expected integer version of that exact Workflow from its latest verified tool result or trusted current snapshot. If it changed, read the current definition and reassess instead of guessing or retrying the old version.

workflow_id.description: Exact owned Workflow ID copied unchanged from workflow_get, an existing validated selection or a successful Workflow tool result. It must be active; do not substitute a name, entity ID, parent ID or guessed ID. An already bound parent cannot switch to a different Workflow.

output_schema.description: Successful technical child Run result; output remains a string and may report PARTIAL, FAILED or NEEDS_USER_INPUT business state.

error.description: Null for this successful child result. Tool failures use the outer {ok:false,error:{code,message,retryable}} envelope.

output.description: Child final output as a JSON string, not an already parsed object. Parse its business status. Large results may instead contain truncated=true and full_output_run_id with omitted evidence; do not execute the child again to retrieve omitted content.

run_id.description: Actual child Run identifier. Technical success alone does not establish business completion.

name: data_describe_table
description: Read the authorized field catalog for one dataset before choosing query projections or filters.

dataset.description: Exact dataset name from data_list_tables. The returned fields apply to this dataset only; do not infer field names from another dataset.

output_schema.description: Authorized fields for one dataset; use them in fields[] and filters[].field.

fields.description: Authorized dataset field catalog; do not infer field names from a different dataset.

name.description: Returned object or dataset name. Workflow-list names may be shortened.
Returned object or dataset name. Workflow-list names may be shortened.

name: data_list_tables
description: List authorized read-only dataset names and fields. This is the catalog, not the rows in those datasets; use its exact names in data_query.

output_schema.description: Authorized dataset names and fields for this owner.

fields.description: Authorized dataset field catalog; do not infer field names from a different dataset.

name.description: Returned object or dataset name. Workflow-list names may be shortened.
Returned object or dataset name. Workflow-list names may be shortened.

name: data_query
description: Read exact projected fields from one archived authorized dataset. Use the catalog for field names and preserve each ID namespace. All filters are AND; no SQL or custom joins. has_more describes remaining rows, not whether the task is complete; inspect page_limit_reason and read further pages only when needed.

dataset.description: One exact archived dataset name from data_list_tables. The current owner and active-connection authorization are enforced by the host; selecting a dataset does not select another user.

fields.description: One to 32 distinct catalog field names to return. Include the identifiers and scope fields needed to verify and cite these rows; fields absent from this dataset are rejected.

items.description: Exact field name from data_describe_table for the selected dataset.

filters.description: Optional predicates, combined with AND; omission applies no additional user-selected predicates. Use verified scope and object identifiers when needed. Adding a predicate for a missing course/class field can exclude account-level notices; no implicit course filter, SQL or custom join is added.

items.description: One predicate applied to the selected dataset. Every predicate in filters must match (AND); no OR groups or joins are supported.

field.description: Exact field name from this dataset's catalog. Fields are dataset-specific; use the catalog's identifiers, not guessed SQL columns.

operator.description: Comparison: eq/ne compare exact values; contains is a case-sensitive literal substring, not a wildcard or regular expression. lt/lte/gt/gte compare timestamp fields chronologically and other fields as text. contains is not supported for timestamp fields.

value.description: Literal comparison value, always a string (including numeric-looking IDs). Timestamp fields require an RFC3339 timestamp with timezone. Copy IDs from the matching dataset's evidence; a change_id, platform record ID, native external_id and academic item ID are not interchangeable.

limit.description: Maximum requested rows, from 1 to 100; omission uses the handler default of 20. A byte-limited page may contain fewer rows without shortening field contents.

offset.description: Zero-based starting row; omission starts at 0. For a needed next page use the result's exact next_offset with unchanged dataset, fields and filters; never calculate it from limit. At an offset boundary report incomplete coverage instead of inventing another offset.

output_schema.description: One bounded page of exact selected source fields; inspect has_more and continuation metadata before claiming coverage.

has_more.description: More matching results remain, not a statement that the current task needs more investigation.

next_offset.description: Use this returned offset with unchanged query fields/filters for another page; absence with offset_limit means this query cannot continue.

page_limit_reason.description: Why a page stopped: byte_budget or offset_limit. At offset_limit report the coverage boundary rather than inventing a cursor.

rows.description: Complete values for requested fields on this page; field availability and timestamp meaning come from the selected dataset catalog.

name: data_search
description: Discover evidence in archived authorized data using literal OR keywords. Hits are summaries: if _truncated_fields identifies shortened fields needed for the answer, use data_query to read the exact record. Searching does not establish course or personal applicability; assess hit scope. Read further pages only when needed for the task.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding result. Omit on the first page. For the next page reuse the cursor unchanged with the same keywords and datasets; do not invent or decode it.

datasets.description: Optional dataset names to search; omission searches all six supported datasets. This selects datasets only: no course, connection or group filter is added implicitly. Check each hit's scope against the task before using it as evidence.

items.description: One supported archived dataset name, as returned by the authorized data catalog.

keywords.description: One to twenty distinct nonempty literal search phrases. Matching is case-insensitive OR across phrases, not a requirement that every word match. Use identifying title fragments or known terms rather than SQL, regular expressions or instructions.

items.description: One literal phrase, up to 256 characters; leading/trailing whitespace is ignored by the archived-data search service.

limit.description: Maximum hits requested on this page, from 1 to 100. Omit to use the handler default of 50; byte budgets may produce a shorter page.

output_schema.description: Literal OR keyword discovery across authorized datasets; hits can be summaries and must retain source scope when used.

coverage.description: Coverage of each dataset for this query, not all user knowledge or all source history.

complete.description: Whether this search's dataset coverage is complete under its reported bounds.

dataset.description: Dataset containing the hit or coverage entry.

matched.description: Match count reported for this dataset and search query.

has_more.description: More matching results remain, not a statement that the current task needs more investigation.

hits.description: Search summaries; fields marked in _truncated_fields must be queried by exact identifiers when full text matters.

dataset.description: Dataset containing the hit or coverage entry.

row.description: Dataset-specific search summary; not a complete source record when marked truncated.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation from this search; reuse only with unchanged keywords/datasets.

name: memory_create
description: Create PUB, own Agent PRI or current Workflow PRI memory. Prefer PRI for unverified inferences; never choose another user. Omitted classification defaults to own PRI, BASE, L1, active.

category.description: Application-chosen category, empty by default on create. An explicit empty string clears it on update; omission preserves it. No prescribed category taxonomy.

content.description: Complete textual content of this memory, with sources and uncertainty as needed. Required on create; on update this replaces the whole text, while omission preserves it.

is_personal.description: Whether the content concerns the user's personal facts; create defaults to false. This classification grants no permissions. Update omission preserves it.

level.description: Organizational level label L0 through L3; create defaults to L1. Choose a suitable level without inferring ownership or access from it; update omission preserves it.

memory_type.description: BASE is stable knowledge; TEMP is changeable knowledge. Create defaults to BASE; update omission preserves the value. TEMP alone does not set an expiry.

owner_agent_id.description: For Agent PRI, use only the current trusted agent_id. When both private owners are omitted on create, defaults to this Agent even if a Workflow is bound. Set null to clear this owner when moving to another allowed scope.

owner_workflow_id.description: For Workflow PRI, copy the currently bound workflow_id exactly. Cannot choose an unbound Workflow. PRI requires exactly one private owner; PUB requires neither. Omission on update preserves ownership; null clears this owner.

parent_memory_id.description: Optional accessible parent memory_id, copied from a read result; null clears the parent. Omission on create means no parent, and omission on update preserves it. Hierarchy cannot grant access.

priority.description: Retrieval priority, default 0 on create. Higher values sort first; update omission preserves it. It does not indicate confidence or grant access.

source_refs.description: Source references using exact IDs and provenance from read results. Legacy strings and application-defined JSON references are accepted; known complete record mappings are checked. Supplied arrays replace, never append; null clears, omission on update preserves. Some host staging modes require nonempty sources.

status.description: Knowledge status; create defaults to active. Archived/invalid entries remain stored but are excluded from default searches. Update omission preserves the current status.

structured_content.description: Optional application-defined JSON object. A supplied object replaces the entire field, not a deep merge; null clears it; omission on update preserves it.

title.description: Concise memory title. Required on create; update omission preserves it. An explicitly supplied title must be nonempty.

valid_from.description: Optional validity start as RFC3339 with timezone. Null clears this bound; omission on update preserves it. This is knowledge validity, not source publication time.

valid_until.description: Optional exclusive validity end as RFC3339 with timezone, later than valid_from when both exist. Null clears expiry; omission on update preserves it.

visibility.description: PUB shares within the current user only; PRI belongs to this Agent or the currently bound Workflow. On create defaults to PRI; on update omission preserves the old value. Changing scope rechecks access.

output_schema.description: Saved memory with server identity and actual scope; not a Workflow definition or external action.

level.description: Optional exact organizational level filter; omitted includes all levels.

owner_agent_id.description: Optional exact private-owner filter; only the current trusted agent_id is allowed. This filter does not grant additional scope.

validity.description: Defaults to current using stored validity bounds and the repository clock. expired/future select those intervals; all removes this time filter but not status filtering.

visibility.description: Optional exact visibility filter within the current user's authorized scope; omitted includes both accessible PUB and PRI.

initial_private_memories.description: Optional initial memories, committed atomically to the new Workflow PRI. Each seed requires title, content and source_refs; categories and number of topics are chosen by the model.

category.description: Application-chosen category, empty by default on create. An explicit empty string clears it on update; omission preserves it. No prescribed category taxonomy.

content.description: Complete textual content of this memory, with sources and uncertainty as needed. Required on create; on update this replaces the whole text, while omission preserves it.

is_personal.description: Whether the content concerns the user's personal facts; create defaults to false. This classification grants no permissions. Update omission preserves it.

level.description: Organizational level label L0 through L3; create defaults to L1. Choose a suitable level without inferring ownership or access from it; update omission preserves it.

memory_type.description: BASE is stable knowledge; TEMP is changeable knowledge. Create defaults to BASE; update omission preserves the value. TEMP alone does not set an expiry.

priority.description: Retrieval priority, default 0 on create. Higher values sort first; update omission preserves it. It does not indicate confidence or grant access.

source_refs.description: Required nonempty source references for this initial memory; 1–100 strings or objects. Seed sources are stricter than ordinary legacy memory references; they are committed atomically with the new Workflow.

items.description: A nonempty source identifier string or nonempty application-defined reference object copied from real evidence.

oneOf.description: Real nonempty source identifier; do not invent or reinterpret IDs.
Nonempty source reference object retaining its real provenance; host validates supported complete mappings.

structured_content.description: Optional complete structured knowledge object for this new memory. This seed cannot select a different owner or private scope.

title.description: Concise memory title. Required on create; update omission preserves it. An explicitly supplied title must be nonempty.

name.description: Complete Workflow name, required on create and update; on update replaces the old name.

parent_workflow_id.description: Optional owned parent Workflow ID from workflow_get/list. Create omission means a root. Parent is immutable on update: omission preserves it, and an explicit ID must equal the existing parent.

status.description: Create defaults to draft. Update omission preserves existing status; an explicit value changes it. Active Workflows must have a valid specific entity under the host's policy. Only active/current definitions can be dispatched for execution.

output_schema.description: Created Workflow definition or host staging representation; creation is not business task execution. A Learner staging result is uncommitted until the host completion receipt.

created_at.description: Object creation time, distinct from source publication or event time.

created_by_agent_id.description: Creating Agent identifier, not the current user or source author.

definition.description: Workflow business definition. workflow_list returns only a shortened entity/goal summary; use workflow_get before changes or execution.

description.description: Stored explanation. Workflow-list descriptions may be shortened.

name.description: Returned object or dataset name. Workflow-list names may be shortened.

owner_user_id.description: Trusted owner identity; not a selectable user scope or operation authorization.

parent_workflow_id.description: Optional immutable parent Workflow identifier; omitted for root Workflows.

profile_initialization.description: Optional atomic initialization receipt, not evidence that a business task executed.

content_sha256.description: Digest of the committed initialization content.

count.description: Number of objects in this receipt.

memory_ids.description: Exact identifiers of atomically saved private memories.

owner_workflow_id.description: Private Workflow owner, when present; access still requires trusted Workflow binding or staging selection.

verified.description: Host verification of this receipt only; not proof a student completed an assignment.

visibility.description: PUB is shared only within this user; PRI belongs to the indicated Agent or Workflow.

status.description: Returned object status; inspect it before assuming the object is active or the business task is complete.

updated_at.description: Last object update time, not necessarily current source observation.

version.description: Persisted integer Workflow version, required as the expected version when updating or dispatching.

workflow_id.description: Server Workflow identifier; copy exactly. Dispatch also requires its active current version.

name: workflow_delete
description: Permanently delete an owned Workflow with no child Workflows. In the production repository its version history and private memories are cascaded; their memory relations are deleted and child memories detached. No undo or expected-version parameter. Read first, obtain the required authorization, and reconcile after uncertain results; repeated deletion may return not found. Staging hosts defer changes until commit.

workflow_id.description: Exact owned workflow_id returned by workflow_get/list/create; not an entity ID, source record ID or run_id.

deleted.description: Deletion acknowledgement; does not imply undo support or idempotent repeat deletion.

name: workflow_list
description: List owned Workflow summaries in workflow_id order. Default page size 20, maximum 100. definition contains only entity identity and a short goal; name/description can be shortened. No has_more is returned: a full page may need continuation using its last workflow_id. Call workflow_get for the complete definition before execution or changes.

after.description: Exclusive workflow_id cursor: omit for the first page, otherwise copy the final workflow_id of the preceding page unchanged. Ordering is by ID, not creation time.

limit.description: Maximum summaries on this page, default 20, at most 100. A page is not proof that every owned Workflow has been examined.

output_schema.description: At most limit Workflow summaries ordered by ID. For another page use the last workflow_id as after; no has_more field is returned. Read workflow_get for full definitions.

name: workflow_update
description: Replace the complete name and definition using an expected version. Omitted status, description and immutable parent are preserved; explicit description empty clears it and explicit status changes it. This is not a deep merge of definition. Read the full Workflow first; reconcile uncertain writes before retrying.

definition.description: Complete application-defined Workflow definition. Required on create/update; update replaces the entire object, not a deep merge. Preserve unrelated rules yourself. A definition alone does not execute a workflow or grant tool permissions.

description.description: Human-readable purpose. Create defaults to empty; update omission preserves the existing description, while an explicit empty string clears it.

name.description: Complete Workflow name, required on create and update; on update replaces the old name.

parent_workflow_id.description: Optional owned parent Workflow ID from workflow_get/list. Create omission means a root. Parent is immutable on update: omission preserves it, and an explicit ID must equal the existing parent.

status.description: Create defaults to draft. Update omission preserves existing status; an explicit value changes it. Active Workflows must have a valid specific entity under the host's policy. Only active/current definitions can be dispatched for execution.

version.description: Expected integer version from the current workflow_get result. A stale version is rejected before saving and the repository still performs an atomic version check; reread rather than blindly retrying.

workflow_id.description: Exact owned workflow_id from workflow_get/list; cannot select another user's Workflow.

output_schema.description: Updated Workflow definition or uncommitted staging state. Metadata omitted from this update is preserved; definition is replaced as a whole.
